items.name: chain-selector
items.title: Chain Selector
items.description: Network switcher for wagmi apps, as a popover (ChainSelector) or dialog (ChainSelectorDialog). Shows the current chain with its icon, lists every chain in the wagmi config (optionally grouped into mainnet/testnet tabs), marks the active chain, shows a per-row spinner while switching, and surfaces wallet errors inline; a rejected request shows as cancelled, not as an error. Wraps useSwitchChain, useChains and useChainId. Flags a wallet on an unsupported chain as 'Wrong network', and takes a chainMeta slot for per-chain detail. Icon slots are swappable or can be hidden; iconOnly mode keeps an accessible label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Icon button that copies a value to the clipboard, swaps to a checkmark for a moment, and announces 'Copied' to screen readers. Hit area extends past the small visual size. onCopy only fires when the clipboard write succeeds. Icons are swappable. Built on the shadcn Button and the useCopy hook.

items.name: explorer-link
items.title: Explorer Link
items.description: Link to an address, transaction or block on a chain's block explorer, taken from chain.blockExplorers in the wagmi config (current chain by default, or chainId). Opens in a new tab with rel=noopener and a screen-reader note. Default text is 'View on <explorer>'. Renders plain text when the chain has no explorer. Exports useExplorerLink.

items.name: address
items.title: Address
items.description: Address display: shows the ENS name (resolved on mainnet with useEnsName) or the checksummed, truncated 0x1234…abcd, with a copy button and an optional block-explorer link. Inline or pill variant. Full address on hover and for screen readers. Exports useAddressName.

items.name: address-avatar
items.title: Address Avatar
items.description: Round avatar for an address: the ENS avatar (useEnsName + useEnsAvatar on mainnet), or a deterministic gradient derived from the address as a fallback. Accepts a custom image src and a pixel size. Exports useAddressAvatar and addressGradient.

items.name: chain-badge
items.title: Chain Badge
items.description: Static chain chip: chain icon plus name for a chainId, with the name read from the wagmi config ('Chain <id>' for unknown chains). Icon-only mode keeps an accessible label. Also exports ChainIcon, the web3icons network logo with a placeholder for unknown chains, which other 0xui components reuse.

items.name: token-icon
items.title: Token Icon
items.description: Token logo with fallbacks: the token list's logoURI (ipfs:// is resolved through a gateway), then the built-in web3icons icon for the symbol, then the symbol's first letters. Optional chain badge in the corner via chainId. Labelled by the symbol for screen readers. Size in px.

items.name: token-amount
items.title: Token Amount
items.description: Formats a bigint token amount with its decimals, e.g. '1,234.5678 USDC', without float precision loss. Rounds toward zero so balances never look larger than they are, shows '<0.0001' for dust, supports compact notation (1.2M) and an optional fiat value from a price prop. The exact amount shows on hover. Exports formatFiat.

items.name: block-number
items.title: Block Number
items.description: Live block indicator: status dot plus the latest block number, updated as blocks arrive (useBlockNumber with watch). Doubles as an RPC health check. data-phase is loading, live or error, and the dot turns red with 'RPC unavailable' when the RPC fails. Optional explorer link. Exports useLiveBlockNumber.

items.name: gas-price
items.title: Gas Price
items.description: Current gas price in gwei with three significant digits (useGasPrice, refreshed on an interval). Optional low/medium/high tone from per-chain gwei thresholds, exposed as data-tone. Loading and error states. Exports useGasPriceInfo, formatGasPrice and gasTone.

items.name: connect-wallet
items.title: Connect Wallet
items.description: Wallet picker for wagmi: 'Connect wallet' button plus dialog listing the config's connectors and EIP-6963 browser extensions with their icons. Recent wallet first, then installed (badged), max N shown with an 'Other wallets' overflow, generic injected hidden when extensions announce themselves. Per-wallet spinner while connecting, a rejected request shows as cancelled (not an error), other errors inline. Exports ConnectWalletDialog (bring your own trigger), useConnectWallet and useWalletOptions. data-phase: idle | connecting | cancelled | error.

items.name: balance
items.title: Balance
items.description: Native or ERC-20 balance of the connected account (or any address) formatted with TokenAmount. ERC-20 balance, decimals and symbol are read in one multicall. Refreshes on an interval. Loading skeleton, '—' on error, nothing when there is no address. Exports useTokenBalance with refetch. data-phase: idle | loading | ready | error.

items.name: account
items.title: Account
items.description: Connected-account button: avatar plus ENS name or truncated address, optional balance. Opens a popover panel with the balance, current chain, copy address, explorer link, connector name and disconnect, plus a children slot for app links. Renders nothing when disconnected. Exports useConnectedAccount.

items.name: wallet-button
items.title: Wallet Button
items.description: The one wallet button for an app header: ConnectWallet when disconnected, Account when connected, and a pulsing placeholder during SSR and while wagmi restores a previous connection, so returning users never see a flash of 'Connect wallet'. Exports useWalletButtonPhase (restoring | disconnected | connected).

items.name: transaction-status
items.title: Transaction Status
items.description: Inline card for one transaction hash: what it does (children), steps from submitted to included in block N to N of M confirmations, the hash with copy, and an explorer link. Reverted transactions are shown with their receipt instead of throwing like wagmi's useWaitForTransactionReceipt. Exports useTransactionStatus and useMinedReceipt. data-phase: pending | confirming | confirmed | reverted | error.

items.name: transaction-button
items.title: Transaction Button
items.description: Button that sends a transaction (sendTransaction) or contract call (writeContract) and shows every step on itself: opens the wallet picker when disconnected, 'Switch to <chain>' on the wrong network, then 'Confirm in wallet…', 'Pending…', 'Done', with a status line and alerts. A wallet rejection shows as cancelled and doesn't call onError. Reverted transactions are detected. disabledReason names the blocker ('Enter an amount'). Exports useTransactionFlow and TxPhase: idle | switching | confirming | pending | success | reverted | cancelled | error.

items.name: amount-input
items.title: Amount Input
items.description: Large borderless decimal input for token amounts that keeps a string value (no float precision loss). type=text with inputMode=decimal; refuses invalid keystrokes and digits past the token's decimals; accepts ',' as the decimal point; cleans up pasted amounts like '$1,000.50'. Optional max with a Max button and an over-max state (aria-invalid). onValueChange returns the string plus the parsed bigint. Exports sanitizeAmountInput and getAmountState.

items.name: token-select
items.title: Token Select
items.description: Searchable token picker (pill trigger plus dialog) for tokens in the token list standard (tokenlists.org, the format of Uniswap's lists), on one chain. Search by symbol, name or pasted address; quick picks from recent tokens (localStorage) and a popular list; the connected account's balances read in one batch, with held tokens sorted first; arrow-key navigation; a loading state; and pagination (50 rows per page, infinite scroll plus a Show more button) so 400-token lists stay fast. Accepts balances from an indexer via the balances prop, which skips RPC reads. Pair it with useTokenList. Exports TokenSelectDialog, filterTokens, useTokenBalances and the Token type.

items.name: token-input
items.title: Token Input
items.description: Swap/send panel: label, AmountInput, TokenSelect pill, fiat value from a price prop, the connected account's balance of the chosen token with Max, and an 'Insufficient <symbol> balance' state. onValueChange returns the amount as a bigint plus insufficient. readOnly and checkBalance=false for 'you receive' panels.

items.name: address-input
items.title: Address Input
items.description: Recipient input for an address or ENS name: debounced ENS resolution on mainnet (useEnsAddress) with avatar and resolved-address preview, reverse ENS name for pasted addresses, strict checksum validation that catches typos, a paste button, and errors shown after blur rather than while typing. onResolve returns { phase, address, ensName, error }. Exports useAddressInput. data-phase: empty | incomplete | resolving | valid | invalid | not-found.

items.name: approve-button
items.title: Approve Button
items.description: ERC-20 approval gate: reads the allowance (useReadContract allowance) and shows an 'Approve <symbol>' TransactionButton until it covers the amount, then renders children (your action); skips straight to children when already approved. Exact amount by default, unlimited (maxUint256) opt-in. Refetches the allowance after approval. Exports useAllowance.

items.name: network-guard
items.title: Network Guard
items.description: Wrapper that shows a 'This works on <chain>. Switch to <chain>' notice when the connected wallet is on an unsupported network, as a banner above the content or replacing it. Renders children unchanged when disconnected or on a supported chain. A declined switch shows as cancelled. Exports useNetworkGuard.

items.name: sign-message
items.title: Sign Message
items.description: Button that signs a message (EIP-191, useSignMessage) or typed data (EIP-712, useSignTypedData), opening the wallet picker when disconnected. Labeled steps, optional verification through the RPC (works for ERC-1271/6492 smart wallets), message preview, signature with copy. A rejected request shows as cancelled. Exports useSignFlow and SignPhase.

items.name: transaction-toast
items.title: Transaction Toast
items.description: useTransactionToast() returns toastTransaction(hash, options): one Sonner toast that goes from 'Transaction pending' to 'Transaction confirmed' or 'Transaction reverted' (or 'Couldn't track transaction'), with a View-on-explorer action and your description in every state. Waits with viem directly so reverted receipts are handled. Needs the shadcn Toaster mounted once.

items.name: add-token
items.title: Add Token
items.description: 'Add USDC to wallet' button (EIP-747 wallet_watchAsset via useWatchAsset) with adding, added, cancelled and error states. Renders nothing when no wallet is connected.

items.name: send
items.title: Send
items.description: Send block for ETH and ERC-20s: AddressInput (address or ENS) + TokenInput (token, amount, balance, Max) + TransactionButton + TransactionStatus. The button names the next missing thing (Enter a recipient / Enter an amount / Insufficient <symbol> balance) before 'Send <symbol>'. Native currency is sent as value, ERC-20s via transfer(). Exports the sendBlocker and sendRequest helpers.

items.name: swap
items.title: Swap
items.description: Swap block with bring-your-own quotes: two TokenInput panels with a flip button, debounced auto-refreshing quotes from a getQuote(sellToken, buyToken, sellAmount, taker) prop (any aggregator or router), rate row (click to invert), price-impact warning, an ApproveButton step when the sell token needs an allowance, and a swap button naming the blocker (Select a token / Enter an amount / Insufficient balance / Fetching quote / No route found). Exports useSwapQuote, formatRate and the GetQuote/SwapQuote types.

items.name: batch-transaction
items.title: Batch Transaction
items.description: Runs several calls (e.g. approve + swap) as one action: a single wallet prompt via EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls when the wallet reports atomic support (useCapabilities), else one transaction per call, waiting for each. Step list with per-step status, step-counting labels ('Confirm 2 of 3 in wallet…'), network switch, rejection shown as cancelled. mode: auto | atomic | sequential. Exports useBatchTransaction.

items.name: contract-form
items.title: Contract Form
items.description: Read/write forms for any contract generated from its ABI: one collapsible card per function with typed inputs (range-checked ints, checksummed addresses, sized bytes, bool select, JSON arrays/tuples), Read with formatted results for view functions, TransactionButton for writes (plus an ETH value field when payable) naming the first invalid field. Filter with functions=[...] or show=read|write. Exports ContractFunction, parseAbiInput and formatAbiValue.

items.name: portfolio
items.title: Portfolio
items.description: Token holdings block: total fiat value on top, then rows (icon, name, amount, value) sorted by value, for the connected account or any address. Balances for the whole token list are read in one batch; prices are a prop. Pagination (pageSize with Show more). Accepts balances from an indexer (balances prop) instead of RPC reads. Skeleton rows while loading, plus empty, error and disconnected states. Exports usePortfolio.

items.name: transaction-history
items.title: Transaction History
items.description: Transactions sent from this app with live status, persisted in localStorage (synced across tabs, 50 max). Call recordTransaction({ hash, chainId, from, description }) from anywhere (e.g. TransactionButton onSubmitted); pending rows poll for receipts and keep their final status. Filters to the connected account by default. Pass transactions from an indexer (transactions prop) for cross-device history. Paginated with Show more. Exports useTransactionHistory, recordTransaction, updateTransaction and clearTransactionHistory.

items.name: ens-profile
items.title: ENS Profile
items.description: Profile card for an ENS name (forward) or address (primary name): avatar, name, address with copy, description, and website / X / GitHub / email links from text records, read on mainnet. Loading skeleton and not-found state. Exports useEnsProfile, which can read arbitrary text records.

items.name: nft-card
items.title: NFT Card
items.description: Card for an ERC-721 or ERC-1155 token: reads tokenURI or uri (with {id} substitution) and the collection name in one batch, fetches metadata from HTTP, IPFS (configurable gateway), Arweave or inline data: URIs, and shows the image, name, collection, token id and optional traits. Skeleton while loading and a placeholder for missing images or tokens. Exports useNft, fetchNftMetadata, resolveUri and expandTokenUri.

items.name: event-feed
items.title: Event Feed
items.description: Live feed of a contract's events (useWatchContractEvent), newest first, deduplicated, with an optional recent-history backfill (getContractEvents over N blocks), indexed-argument filters, default rows showing the event name and formatted args, and a transaction link per event. role=log for polite announcements. renderEvent for custom rows. initialEvents takes past events from an indexer instead of RPC history. Exports useEventFeed and formatEventArg.

items.name: wagmi-config
items.title: wagmi config + provider
items.description: Starter wagmi setup: lib/wagmi-config.ts (mainnet + sepolia, injected connector, SSR on) and a Web3Provider component that wraps WagmiProvider and a TanStack QueryClientProvider. Install once, wrap your app in <Web3Provider>, then add any 0xui component.

items.name: 0xui-utils
items.title: 0xui utils
items.description: Shared web3 formatting helpers used by 0xui components: truncateAddress (checksummed 0x1234…abcd), formatTokenAmount (bigint + decimals to a locale string without float precision loss, rounds toward zero, compact notation, '<0.0001' for dust), parseAmount (lenient user input to bigint: '.5', '1,000.5', '1.000,5', clamps to token decimals), getExplorerUrl (address/tx/block links from chain.blockExplorers) isUserRejection (detects a dismissed wallet prompt) and resolveUri (ipfs:// and ar:// to HTTP).

items.name: token-list
items.title: Token list
items.description: Token list standard (tokenlists.org, as used by Uniswap) for 0xui: TokenInfo and TokenList types (including tags and extensions such as Uniswap's bridgeInfo), parseTokenList (validates, drops non-EVM entries such as Solana tokens, checksums addresses), fetchTokenList (http, ipfs, ar), mergeTokenLists, nativeToken(chain) (lists don't include ETH), applyTokenFilters (allowlist/whitelist and blocklist by address or chainId:address), NATIVE_TOKEN_ADDRESS and UNISWAP_DEFAULT_LIST.

items.name: use-token-list
items.title: useTokenList
items.description: Load one or more token lists by URL (e.g. https://tokens.uniswap.org) with TanStack Query (cached for the session, one retry), merge and de-duplicate them, filter to the current or a given chain, apply an allowlist (whitelist) or blocklist, and put the native currency first. Returns { tokens, lists, isLoading, error }, ready for TokenSelect, TokenInput, Swap, Send and Portfolio.

items.name: use-mounted
items.title: useMounted
items.description: SSR guard hook: false during server render and hydration, true afterwards. Keeps browser-only wallet state out of server HTML to avoid hydration mismatches. Built on useSyncExternalStore, so there is no extra render on client-only apps.

items.name: use-copy
items.title: useCopy
items.description: Clipboard hook: copy(text) writes to the clipboard and sets copied=true for a configurable timeout. Resolves false when clipboard access is unavailable or denied.
